title: A Voice That Touches the Soul: The Quran and Adhan in Your Baby's First World
summary:
Imagine your infant, sleeping peacefully in their crib, or gazing at you with wide eyes, while a warm sound fills the room. It might be the sound of a gentle recitation of the Holy Quran, or the soft call of the Adhan echoing from afar. In these quiet moments, your little one doesn't understand the words, but they find comfort in the calm voice and reassuring atmosphere around them, forming the first building blocks of familiarity and reassurance.

What is repeated to an infant's ear becomes familiar and beloved to them. This is not a call for early memorization or dry indoctrination, but rather an invitation to plant the seed of comfort with the words of Allah Almighty from their tender age. When your child hears the Quran and the Adhan in a gentle and loving voice, you are not just offering them sounds; you are opening a window to a world of spiritual serenity, nourishing their sound innate nature with what connects it to its Creator, and we hope this familiarity will grow into love for the Book of Allah when they grow older, by Allah's will.

Make these sounds a natural part of your child's daily environment, without pretense or burden. Choose times when they are calm and receptive, such as during feeding or before sleep. Remember that the goal is to build a bridge of love and reassurance between your child and the words of their Lord, in a smooth and warm way, so that the Quran becomes a companion to their soul from the very beginning. And let this familiarity be a stepping stone toward learning and teaching the Quran when they grow older, for the Prophet ﷺ said: «The best among you are those who learn the Quran and teach it» (Sahih al-Bukhari 5027).
